detail: Each family aims to sell its starting count ÷ 90 a day (10 units: about 1 every 9 days), whatever the days left. Each night Dash compares the last 14 days' sales (recent days count more) with that aim. At or above the aim: the discount holds. Below it: the discount grows, by up to 0.75% a day, in proportion to how far behind (no sales: 0.75%; half the aim: 0.375%). No deadline jump: day 85 works like day 20. Learning from past sales at past prices comes later, from the data platform.
